'''Klubi Sportiv Kastrioti''' is an Albanian professional [[Association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Krujë]]. The club's home ground used to be the [[Kastrioti Stadium]], but after the stadium got closed and demolished, Kastrioti had to move to [[Redi Maloku Stadium]] in [[Fushë-Krujë]], which has a total of 3,000 spectators and they currently compete in the [[Kategoria e Parë]]."}}
